name: Kissproof powder

card.summary: A vintage Chicago face powder brand, Kissproof, marketed as clinging powder that stays put to keep skin matte and even.

quick.overview:
Kissproof was a face powder and cosmetics brand made in Chicago, familiar from vintage advertisements. Its powder was marketed to keep skin soft, matte and evenly covered through the day.

A museum box dated 1935-1950 carries claims including "The Clinging Powder that really clings" and windproof wear.
quick.how: Loose or compact face powder is applied to the face to even tone and reduce shine.
quick.risks: No safety data is documented for the historical product.

lead: Kissproof was a cosmetics brand from Chicago, Illinois; a Kissproof powder box dated 1935-1950 in the Henry Ford Museum collection is marked as made by Kissproof Inc. of Chicago.[1]

The box label advertises the powder as the clinging powder that really clings, with claims that it does not clog pores, uses an exclusive French formula, keeps skin soft and satiny all day, and is windproof.[1]
Face powder is used to even the look of skin and reduce shine.

angle.text: Face powders like Kissproof give a matte, even finish; the brand marketed long-wearing cling.

paras: The surviving packaging emphasises adherence, pore-friendliness and wind resistance.[1]
